messages:
rachel: Heads-up: prepping the internal release note for v1.14. Need a short ops blurb about pin/rollback and the canary cadence. Can someone own ops language?

anil: I can take ops. Will include pin info, rollback criteria, and exact rollback command. Need the final image tag.

deploy-bot: [system] Scheduled deploy: service=inference-api, image=redwood/inference:v1.14.0-canary, window=2024-07-08T03:00Z/2024-07-08T04:00Z, notify=#eng-releases

rachel: Thanks. Docs will write the why/how change bullets. We want 2 short bullets plus a "what to watch" line for internal announce.

jordi: Quick note on rollout: plan 5% -> 25% after 10m -> 100% after 30m if no alerts. Include rollback trigger: sustained error >3% for 5m OR P99 up by 800ms.

clare: Can we include the short mitigation step if latency rises? e.g., flip `kv_cache_heuristic=legacy` or reduce `max_batch=8`.

anil: Add that as intermediate mitigation. Full rollback = set image back to v1.13.7. Runbook snippet:
```
# rollback command
kubectl set image deployment/inference inference=redwood/inference:v1.13.7 -n inference-prod
# wait for rollout and run smoke checks
```

ben: I'll prep the internal announce copy and post a preview link. Who are approvers? ops-oncall + anil + rachel?

ops-oncall: SGTM. I'll be primary decision for rollback during window. Ping at T-40 for readiness and T-10 for final go/no-go.

rachel: Approvals: @anil (ops), @ops-oncall (oncall), @clare (runtime). Ben please tag them in the draft.

ben: Draft posted: https://internal.redwood/docs/drafts/v1.14-internal (preview). Short bullets + rollback runbook + contact list.

clare: Also confirm dedicated pools pin: v1.13.7 for Dedicated, auto-fallback to stable in router if errors spike. Add that to ops blurb.

anil: Confirmed. I'll add the exact kube command and the escalation matrix to the draft.

rachel: Small style ask: keep the release note copy 3 lines max for the Slack blurb: 1) feature summary, 2) impact/risk, 3) ops/rollback.

ben: Will do. Posting a tiny preview at T-20 for final thumbs.

deploy-bot: [system] Reminder scheduled: T-40 preflight (2024-07-08T02:20Z) and T-10 final check (2024-07-08T02:50Z) to #eng-releases.

ops-oncall: I'll run the quick preflight checklist at T-40. If anything looks off, we'll abort the canary.

anil: Adding a small troubleshooting note: if we see degraded KV hits after deploy, try `kv_cache_heuristic=legacy` and monitor hit-rate for 5m.

rachel: Perfect. Thanks all — benching this thread until T-40. :party_parrot:
